meta.title: ULTIMATE Vietnam Travel Guide 2026 - 14 Days in Vietnam
meta.description:
#vietnam #travel #14DaysinVietnam
Planning a trip to Vietnam in 2024?
In this 2 weeks travel guide I will show you how to spend 14 Days in Vietnam including a variety of things to do. Exploring Hanoi, Sapa, Cat Ba, Ha Long Bay, Tam Coc in Ninh Binh, Hue, Da Nang, Hoi An, and Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City)! From North Vietnam to South Vietnam.
At the end, I will show all the costs you can expect in Vietnam!
Ultimate Vietnam Guide, A Travel Documentary.

comments.author: @annienguyen669
comments.text: I would say tips are expected in Vietnam now. For example, when you take a boat trip in Ninh Binh, the standard tip should be VND 50,000 VND~ 1.8$ for boat man. For cyclo, the tip should be VND 50,000 VND~ 1.8$ for cyclo drivers. Cyclo drivers in Hanoi and Hue may ask you directly for tipping which it's not nice in some cases. Thus, in order to avoid awkward situation, you can give tip right after services. It's a small amount when you consider the low income of the labour in Vietnam and how hard they work under the weather.

transcript: Vietnam. What's the first thing that comes to your mind? Hanoi, lanterns, con hats, street food, Saigon, egg, coffee, history, rice fields, temples, Harlong Bay or train street? Everyone has their own bucket list. And on this list, Vietnam ranks among the best. I have lived, worked, and traveled this beautiful, diverse country for over 7 months, and now I want to share my knowledge and experience with you. This is how I would spend 14 days in Vietnam. You will be either arriving in Ho Chi Min or Hanoi. For the sake of simplicity, we start from Hanoi. No worries. This journey works also in reverse. Our journey begins in the lively streets of Hanoi, where the pulse of the city sets the tone for our Vietnam exploration. From Hanoi, we embark on a night bus to Sappa, nestled in the majestic mountains of northern Vietnam, surrounded by verdant rice terraces and the warm hospitality of the local hill tribes. Next, we journey by night bus to Catbar, a picturesque island, where we will do a road trip across the island by motorbike. Our next destination is the legendary Harlong Bay, where we spend a night aboard a cruise ship, sailing among the iconic limestone formations and soaking in its enchanting beauty. Continuing our adventure, we explore the tranquil beauty of Tamco in Ning Bin, also known as the Harlong Bay on land, where towering limestone rise from the emerald waters. Then we head to Hanoi to take a flight to Hui, the former imperial capital of Vietnam, where we delve into the rich history and cultural heritage of the region. From here, we take the train to Daang, a vibrant city on the central coast of Vietnam. 25 minutes away is Hoyan. We explore the ancient streets where lanterns sway gently in the breeze and history comes to life at every turn. Our adventure reaches its peak in the vibrant metropolis of Ho Chi Min City, also known as Saigon, where we discover the energy and excitement of urban life in Vietnam's largest city. Some information you will need before arriving in Vietnam. Best time to visit Vietnam depends on what you want to explore. Northern Vietnam, April to June and September to December. Early October for the green rice terraces. Central Vietnam, February to May. South Vietnam, November to April for dry season. Mentioning these, April should be your goal to go if you want to see all the country. Lastly, at the end of the video, we will break down how much this trip will cost you and show you an alternative budget friendly route if you have more time to spend in Vietnam. Arriving Hanoi, the heart and soul of Vietnam, where you can lose yourself in the chaotic charm of the old quarter. Here are some places to visit. Stroll around the labyrinthine streets of the old quarter and wander through its narrow streets filled with ancient charm and vibrant shops. Try Hanoi's unique and famous egg coffee at the iconic cafe jam, the birthplace of this amazing tasting coffee. Get a customtailored suit crafted by skilled craftsmen in the heart of Hanoi, all within a swift 24-hour time frame. Experience serenity amidst the bustling city by strolling around the picturesque Hong Kim Lake. Home to the historic Nox Sun Temple nestled on its tranquil waters. [Music] Explore the night market at Han Kim Lake. Join locals and fellow travelers alike at Beer Street. Unwind and recharge at Loading Tea Cafe. A cozy spot where vintage decor and aromatic coffee create the perfect ambiance for a leisurely morning. Check out the spectacle of the famous Train Street, where cafes stand just inches away from passing trains, creating a truly unique and mesmerizing experience. Treat your taste buds to the flavors of Vietnam with a mouthwatering banani sandwich, steaming bowl of faux noodle soup, or dectable king rotty pastry. Each offering a unique culinary experience. From Hanoi, we venture north to the picturesque town of Sappa. Best way to reach Sappa is via night bus from Hanoi. It will take you around 6 hours to arrive. Trek through stunning rice terraces, visit local villages, and immerse yourself in the rich culture of the ethnic minority groups. [Music] [Applause] Hop on a night bus to Catbar Island, a hidden gem that is less touristic than the bigger brother Harlong Bay. Here you can rent a bike and do a road trip across the island in just an hour. You can make some stops along the way for mesmerizing views. Next, we set sail to the emerald waters of Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site. Cruise past limestone casts rising from the sea. [Music] Explore hidden caves. Go kayaking. and soak in the serenity of this otherworldly landscape. Traveling inland, we discover the serene beauty of Tamco, often referred to as Halong Bay on land. Embark on a serene boat journey along the river, where towering limestone casts and lush greenery create a breathtaking backdrop for your adventure. Ascend to the summit of Hangmua, where a challenging hike rewards you with panoramic views of Tamco's stunning scenery, including its iconic dragon statue. [Music] Explore the beauty of Tamcock. Wander through its picturesque landscapes and charming villages at your own pace. Whether by zipping through on a motorbike or leisurely pedaling on a bicycle. Step into a world of tranquility and spirituality as you visit Beach Dong Pagoda. From here we go back to Hanoi airport to take a flight to Hugh. Delve into the country's rich history as you explore the majestic imperial city, ancient citadels, and ornate pagodas. [Music] Our journey continues south to the coastal city of Da. Here you can relax on pristine beaches after an exhausting trip in the north. Don't miss the iconic Dragon Bridge, though. Ever since completion in 2013, a fire and water show has been held twice weekly on Saturday and Sunday. Take the chance to visit Bana Hills theme park with its iconic Golden Bridge. [Music] Just a short drive from Daang lies the charming town of Hoyan, a UNESCO World Heritage site renowned for its colorful architecture and lantern lit streets. [Music] Heat. Heat. N. [Music] Yeah. [Music] Our journey concludes in the bustling metropolis of Saigon, also known as Ho Chi Min City. [Music] Dive into the vibrant street life. [Music] Visit historic landmarks such as the Notream Cathedral of Saigon [Music] and do a day trip to Mikong Delta. [Music] I really packed a lot of things into this itinerary because I want to inspire you to have the best time you can. But not to worry if it's too tight a schedule. You can just pick up the things that you like the most and drop those if you didn't. Feel free to tweak any parts to better fit your vision or add any additional details you'd like to highlight about each location. As promised here, the alternative budget friendly route, you could do the whole trip by bus and train as shown in the map. This will take more time. However, if you do it right, you could save up to 70% on accommodation and transportation. For the train, you can book your tickets via the official Vietnamese rail website. If you choose to stay longer, you can add Fukuquok to your list. Fukuquok is a tropical paradise known for its stunning beaches, crystal clear waters, and lush jungles.
